FAQ_details.title: What is .NET in software development?
FAQ_details.description: .NET is a framework developed by Microsoft that provides a set of tools and technologies for building software applications. It offers a common language runtime (CLR) and a class library that simplifies development and ensures cross-platform compatibility.

FAQ_details.title: What does a .NET developer do?

FAQ_details.title: What is the difference between .NET Framework and .NET Core?
FAQ_details.description: .NET Core is a cross-platform, open-source version of the .NET framework, designed for building modern, cloud-native applications. It offers performance improvements, modularity, and flexibility compared to the traditional .NET framework. Nowadays, there’s the most technically advanced version of .Net that is cross-platform and is recommended for new projects. The upcoming version is .Net 9.

FAQ_details.title: Is .NET backend or frontend?
FAQ_details.description: .NET can be used for both backend and frontend development. For backend development, .NET provides frameworks like ASP.NET for building web services and APIs, which we also sometimes use for UI/UX. For frontend development, .NET can be used with technologies like Blazor or Xamarin to create user interfaces.

FAQ_details.title: What is Generative AI?
FAQ_details.description: Generative AI refers to artificial intelligence systems that can create new content including text, images, audio, video, and code. These systems learn patterns from existing data and generate novel outputs.

FAQ_details.title: How is Generative AI different from traditional AI?
FAQ_details.description: While traditional AI focuses on analyzing and classifying existing data, generative AI creates new content. It can produce original text, images, music, and more based on learned patterns.

FAQ_details.title: What are common use cases for Generative AI?
FAQ_details.description: Common use cases include content creation, chatbots, code generation, image synthesis, personalization, data augmentation, creative design, and automated documentation.

FAQ_details.title: Is Generative AI content original?
FAQ_details.description: Yes, generative AI creates original content based on patterns learned from training data. However, it's important to review and validate generated content for accuracy and appropriateness.

FAQ_details.title: How do you ensure quality of AI-generated content?
FAQ_details.description: We implement quality control measures including fine-tuning on your data, prompt engineering, output filtering, human review processes, and continuous monitoring and improvement.

FAQ_details.title: What is the cost of Generative AI solutions?
FAQ_details.description: Costs vary based on complexity, model selection, customization needs, and usage volume. Projects typically range from $25,000 for basic implementations to $300,000+ for enterprise solutions.
